description: The file is a React component for a Next.js frontend, managing a multi-step persona generation workflow. It handles document uploads, orchestrates backend calls for persona creation, polls for build status, manages state transitions, and renders the UI including header, progress steps, upload interface, and persona display/editing.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array if possible, filtering out non-string entries or empty strings.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely converts a value to a JSON string, falling back to String() if serialization fails.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a readable error message from an unknown error object or string.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label, used for avatar display, defaulting to '•' for empty strings.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value in an object following a path array; returns the value and the found path for debugging.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys of an object and nested 'artifacts' keys for debugging orchestrations.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the persona JSON object from a complex orchestration record, prioritizing certain paths and shape detection.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData structure, handling flexible formats and fields.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the persona builder workflow, including uploading documents, orchestration requests, polling status, rendering UI states, and handling editing/saving personas.
